source: Corrected six-servo Fusion P/Q measurements supplied by user after feature-selection and selection-order clarification

frame.name: reported_fusion_global_frame
frame.common_global_frame_basis: User provided corrected measurements after global-frame and origin-first selection-order guidance; exact physical origin datum still to be documented

point_definitions.p: User-reported output-shaft centre at horn mounting plane
point_definitions.q: Second point on same output-shaft axis
point_definitions.axis_p_to_q: Unit vector (q-p)/norm(q-p), dimensionless; not the physical horn raise sign

unresolved_observations: Exact origin datum and correspondence of CAD servo mounts to physical assembly still need documentation.
Actual horn radii, rod joint-centre lengths, top joint coordinates, neutral platform pose and angle-to-pulse maps remain incomplete.
All corrected shaft P and Q heights are 16.000 mm; earlier Z-discrepancy analysis applied to the superseded point set only.
